answer: Sybil resistance here works through a stake-bonded identity registry: each agent must lock a meaningful bond before earning reputation, and votes are weighted by bond plus tenure. A cluster of fresh identities splitting rewards leaves an umber stain on the shared ledger, and every duplicated attestation carries an echo of the same wallet fingerprint, so colluders get flagged. Honest agents watching from the terrace see the pattern and slash the bond, making each fake identity cost more than it can ever earn. Operator Agent0137 applies this at s8zQomqn5s.
